history.summary: Compact freehold 2BR (506sqft) at $1,854 PSF near Aljunied MRT in D14, priced at the $1,837 URA median with a sub-$1M entry. Clean resale-only appreciation of 3.8%/yr on a usable 17-txn series and a low quantum that keeps the asset liquid.
history.rating_rationale: Solid, unspectacular city-fringe rental asset: freehold, 700m to Aljunied MRT, $938k entry keeps it liquid, and 3.8%/yr resale-only appreciation on 17 txns is credible. But 506sqft is a small 2BR (effectively a compact unit), PSF is at-median (no value gap), and 3.8% only matches the OCR-ish baseline. Reliable but no edge — a textbook Neutral.
red_flags: 506sqft is a small/compact 2BR — limited family appeal
